descriptionChirho: The cardinal number seven, used independently or in compound numbers (seventeen, twenty-seven, etc.), across all grammatical forms (masculine/feminine, construct/absolute, with prefixed prepositions, conjunctions, article, or pronominal suffixes).
The number seven used adverbially to indicate repetition or multiplicity, typically with פְּעָמִים (times), sometimes carrying the connotation of completeness or fullness.
